title: chelone glabra subsp. linifolia
intro: Chelone glabra subsp. linifolia, commonly known as the snakeroot or white turtlehead, is a plant species in the borage family that is native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing fever and inflammation, as well as its ability to aid in the treatment of respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Chelone glabra subsp. linifolia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to loosen and clear mucus from the lungs and airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as tussilagin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
